expectations.text: Defines D value as the time at a given temperature for a 1-log (90%) reduction
expectations.evidence: D = time for 90% / 1-log kill at a temperature

expectations.text: Defines z value as the temperature change that changes D by 10-fold (about 18 F / 10 C for C. botulinum)
expectations.evidence: z ~18 F (10 C) for 10-fold change in D

expectations.text: Explains the 12D botulinum cook with D250 of about 0.2 min giving 2.4 min
Calculates D240 = 0.2 x 10^(10/18) which is about 0.72 min, giving about 3.3 log reductions
expectations.evidence: D240 = 0.2 x 10^(10/18) ~ 0.72 min; 3.3 logs; cross-checked with F0 0.67

expectations.text: Concludes the batch is under-processed and unsafe: hold, do not release, and reprocess or destroy with a process authority's evaluation
expectations.evidence: Not safe: hold lot, process authority, reprocess or destroy

expectations.text: Mentions why low-acid foods matter (pH above 4.6 and water activity above 0.85, C. botulinum can grow)
